top_reviews.content:
Make reservations well in advance!! When we got there everyone was waiting for the doors to open, eager to be the first ones in, so thankful they got a reservation. We made ours easily others had to work hard for the date and time they wanted.

We were honored to met 2 of the 3 Nonnas, Maria who is Italian and resident chef, the other from Bangladesh.

The food was good, but you go for the experience and to give back. Would go again in a heart beat. And make room there is a lot of food!!

Went with my best friend and her daughter.  We all loved the movie so we wanted to experience the food.  Our out of town nonna was from Pakistan.  They always have an Italian nonna.  We mixed and matched our menus from both.  Everything was delicious.  The place is small. You have a 2 hour limit but it didnt feel rushed.  Would definitely return.

We had great talks with Nonna Maria, felt very welcome and had great food aswell - what else can you ask for?! Its a super cute place, with a great concept and I will definitely come again! 🥰
Make sure you have a reservation a few weeks ahead 😉

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

What an absolutely unforgettable experience at Enoteca Maria! From the moment we walked through the doors, we were welcomed with genuine warmth and hospitality that made us feel like part of the family. The atmosphere is cozy, inviting, and full of character, creating the perfect setting to enjoy an authentic meal and great conversation.

Every dish was outstanding. You can truly taste the love, tradition, and care that goes into each recipe. The fresh ingredients, incredible flavors, and homemade quality make every bite memorable. It’s easy to see why this restaurant has earned such a wonderful reputation. Dining here isn’t just about the food—it’s about experiencing different cultures and traditions brought together around the table.

A very special shoutout to the owner. It was an absolute pleasure meeting him and having the opportunity to chat. His passion for preserving family recipes, honoring tradition, and creating a place where everyone feels welcome is inspiring. He has built something truly unique, and his kindness and genuine appreciation for his guests make the experience even more meaningful. You can tell this restaurant is a true labor of love.

Thank you to the entire team for making our visit so special. Amazing food, exceptional service, and an atmosphere that leaves a lasting impression. If you’re anywhere near Staten Island, this is a restaurant you simply have to experience. We can’t wait to come back and share this hidden gem with friends and family. Five stars aren’t enough—highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Decent but overhyped. The apps are tasty but it ends there. The mains and desert were hit or miss. Nothing stood out. Good for those that do not cook at home or did not grow up with a grandma that knew her way around the kitchen. Seating is tight as well, so be prepared to get friendly with the adjacent tables. Also, don't forget your cash for drinks or extras as they do not accept credit cards. With add-ons expect the total price to jump an additional $20 per person. Come here to support the elderly as this is a 501c3, but manage your exoectations. Finally, no hosting celebrations here as seating is strictly limited to 2 hours.

I've wanted to create something like this for so long, and it was everything I hoped for. Great food, excellent atmosphere. You can taste the love 💯 reservations were hard to get but I think they've fixed their website so it might be easier now. Come hungry and ready for a hug!

We had the best Italian meals of our lives!
It was impossible to book via WhatApp and the voice-mail was full every time I called. This is because they receive hundreds of calls per day due to the Netflix movie.
We flew into New York from New Zealand,  took the Staten Island ferry over and hoped for the best.
When we arrived, there was a line of people standing outside hoping to get a sitting if a booking finished early or didn't show. We joined that line! And we were very very lucky... it was 12.30pm, and we managed to wait approximately an hour before we were told that there was a space for us.
I just loved everything about this cute little place.
The food was absolutely insane with rich Italian roots. We couldn't get enough of each dish.
Even though it is tricky to get a sitting, if you do... you won't regret it. Delish is an understatement!

Pros: The food is good and has a "homemade" flavor and the portions are generous. The price per entree is not bad either.

Con: The only issue we had was the reservation system.  It was impossible to get a response from WhatsApp or email when we attempted to make a reservation.
We had to go in person to Staten Island to make a reservation in person with the owner.  The system is not optimal.
In the end, we ended up securing a reservation and ate at Nonnas.
We came across people who had traveled from abroad to eat there, and had the same issue,  no response when reaching out.  So be warned,  please.

The only reason as to why we went back is because this was a dream for my family member.

If you’re looking for a place in LA with amazing sushi, creative cocktails, great service, and a lively bar and dancing atmosphere, this is definitely a spot worth visiting. We had a fantastic night and will absolutely be back!

There was a minimum of $150 per person which is ridiculous given the poor quality of food. We ordered Waygu on hot stone and the Waygu arrived without the hot stone and undercooked. top_reviews.content: Absolutely amazing! A hidden gem right up from the DoubleTree Hotel! We had reservations for 2 and were seated on the rooftop. It was absolutely beautiful and we had a nice view of the cathedral. The atmosphere was perfect. A very nice intimate experience; no music blasting loudly, just the satisfying sounds of the night along with distinct chatter. It’s not loud, music is played a great tempo/volume where you can get that intimate dining experience. The stars of the show were the server experience and food! Servers were very attentive and immersed you into a world of interaction with the food—it should tell you that it will be amazing. The pastas and the filet mignon were DELICIOUS. The filet mignon being arguably affordable than your average expensive steakhouse … we were super impressed. Long story short, this place deserves all the love.

We visited this restaurant for my husband’s birthday, and after reading some negative reviews beforehand, I was honestly a little nervous. Thankfully, our experience was fantastic!

The service was attentive from start to finish, and we had an amazing time. I ordered the ribeye, and it was absolutely divine—the seasoning was perfect. We started with the calamari, which was fresh, crispy, and delicious. For drinks, I had the Duomo 51 Fizz and the Lychee Martini, and both were refreshing and well-made.

A special thank you to the manager, Roland, who was incredibly kind and helped make our visit even more enjoyable. We also had a great view, which made the evening even more memorable. The gratuity was already included in the bill, which was completely fine with us.

Overall, we had a wonderful birthday dinner and would definitely come back!

The atmosphere and the view are beautiful, and the restaurant is family-friendly. We visited with our 1-year-old baby and felt comfortable. The service was polite and attentive, although nothing particularly special. Prices are slightly above average, which would be fine if the food matched the quality.

Unfortunately, the food was disappointing. I ordered the risotto, and it had a strong smell that made it difficult to enjoy. It was nothing like the risotto I’ve had in Italy. My husband ordered the chicken, and it also had an unpleasant smell, as if it had been cooked earlier and reheated rather than freshly prepared. We barely ate our meals and left most of the food on our plates. The staff kindly offered to pack it to go, but we declined because we didn’t want to take it with us.

We came for the food, and sadly it did not meet our expectations. I wouldn’t return.

The best restaurant experience that I have had in a long time. The service was excellent. Cocktails were amazing. Food was delectable. I will be back to try more dishes and have desert. I was dancing in my seat enjoying the delicious food, sounds and sights.

Chris was an amazing waiter! Me and my boyfriend celebrated our 3rd anniversary at Duomo and was pleasantly supposed by the great food and even better service! We will definitely recommend this place to our friends and family.

I recently visited Bossa Nova Brazilian Cuisine and had a wonderful experience enjoying their flavorful Brazilian-inspired dishes. The restaurant has a warm and inviting atmosphere that makes it a great place for a casual lunch, family dinner, or a night out with friends. The menu offers a wide variety of Brazilian specialties along with other international favorites, all prepared with fresh, high-quality ingredients. I ordered one of their signature dishes, and it was beautifully presented, generously portioned, and full of rich, authentic flavors. The meat was tender and perfectly seasoned, while the rice, beans, and fresh sides complemented the meal perfectly. Every bite reflected the restaurant's attention to quality and traditional cooking. I also enjoyed one of their refreshing beverages, which paired nicely with the meal. The staff were friendly, attentive, and professional throughout my visit. They provided excellent service, answered my questions about the menu, and made sure everything arrived promptly. The restaurant was clean, comfortable, and had a relaxed atmosphere that made the dining experience even more enjoyable. I appreciated the generous portions and the consistency of the food. The prices were reasonable considering the quality and amount of food served. Bossa Nova Brazilian Cuisine is an excellent choice for anyone looking to enjoy delicious Brazilian flavors in a welcoming environment. I left very satisfied with both the food and the service. I would definitely return and highly recommend this restaurant to anyone who enjoys authentic cuisine, generous portions, and outstanding hospitality.

top_reviews.content:
This dinner experience was truly special - intimate, thoughtful, and unlike anything I’ve done before. Chef David’s storytelling brought the meal to life as he shared the Nigerian roots and cultural significance behind each dish, which made the experience so much more meaningful and engaging. Learning about the history and traditions connected to the food added a beautiful depth to the evening.

The company was wonderful, creating a warm, communal atmosphere that felt both welcoming and memorable. And the food was absolutely outstanding. The flavors and spices were rich and perfectly balanced, with the honey bean couscous, bread, and jollof standing out as unforgettable highlights. They were incredibly accommodating of my dietary restrictions, as well.

I would highly recommend this experience to anyone looking for more than just a meal - this was food, culture, and connection all in one.

David was an absolutely incredible host, storyteller, and educator! My partner and I had the most fulfilling, entertaining, and FILLING experience during our intimate dinner. Sharing stories, learning about West African food and culture, laughing and connecting across a table of beautiful and immensely flavorful and exciting food — it’s everything we could ever want in a dining experience! The joining of homes while also creating a pocket of home unique to the evening we shared. We had a blast and highly recommend David and the ILE team for a one of a kind experience! and shoutout to sous chef Jeffrey! We voted for puff puff to stay on the menu so hopefully there’s less baking in your future 😂 thank you guys again for a wonderful evening, we’ll run it back again soon! 🫶🏼

Let me start off by saying the food was delicious. However, for the price you can get just as superb food with much better atmosphere and service. I would not recommend this place.

They only provided water even though they promised a nonalcoholic cocktail that we were told we could bring spirits to mix into. Upon asking at the end of the meal, their excuse was that the head chef was out. So they could make an entire meal without the head chef but not a premixed cocktail? We ended up taking shots of our tequila instead of having a cocktail to mix it into. They could’ve even just offered some juice concoction instead of literally nothing.

The food was good but does not look like the pictures shown. It is family style so piles of food are served on platters. That’s fine, but the photos here are extremely misleading.

The experience was a bit unorganized and not optimized. There was a host fiddling trying to play videos on an iPad before the course was served but the audio was poor (in an echoey concrete loft) and the screen was tiny. Would’ve just preferred an intimate setting where they explained the food instead of trying to achieve (and missing the mark on) theater. Then the chefs were late serving food so on the last course the host basically rushed us out so their next seating could come in, so we scarfed down our dessert then had to catch up with friends outside in the cold instead of over the promised cocktail.

The space was small but I expected a smaller table for an intimate setting instead of two huge tables squeezed into as much space as possible, maximizing profits but leaving no logistical room to get to the bathroom or for the servers to remove plates except reaching through other seated patrons.

Ultimately I’m giving 2 stars for the taste of the food but for the price I paid, I left feeling let down and would not recommend. Better to spend your money at a fine dining establishment for better marks on everything all around.

Had a wonderful meal at Ilé LA.  The entire 4-course dinner was presented beautifully, was well-flavored, and vibrant.  The food was nourishing and so was the history and storytelling behind it.  The care and intention in the food and presentation really made for a special evening.  Highly recommend if you’d like to experience elevated pan-African cuisine.  The theme of our dinner was a taste of West Africa and included pepper soup, a honey bean hummus, and salad, jollof rice, lamb, catfish, chicken, and fonio, a non-alcoholic beverage, and puff puff with ice cream.  Everything was excellent!  Would absolutely eat at Chef David’s table again.

This was such a magical night. The courses followed a beautiful love story, so we eagerly awaited each plate and the story that went with it. The presentation was incredible. The service was perfection and fun. Hats off to the chef because it couldn’t have been a better experience. I honestly can’t pick a favorite course because each was so delicious with many layers of flavor.
If you enjoy Nigerian food, get ready to reimagine your favorite dishes. Nom nom! Thanks Chef Eros and team!

I’ll start with WOW! This is experience was magical from start to finish. A dance with culture and food. Filled with great energy and people. I’d recommend it to anyone looking to experience a new level of taste. Chef Eros has brought his Nigerian roots to Los Angeles and his passion for food is definitely well received from every bite. I loved the family style dining experience and being able to connect with some new creatives. I can’t wait to experience it again. Thank you for having me.

Chef Eros gave us such an amazing experience! The ambience, the food, his stories… One word, AMAZING!
Would definitely recommend.

12/10 experience, without a doubt. Every component of the evening was so well thought out and highly detailed: from the curation of the menu, to the compelling performance given by Chef Eros- everything. Not only was Chef Eros and the food incredible (which again, was beyond luscious), but his team of three were diligent and David's attentiveness was highly noticed too. For me, it was a warm evening that was filled with nostalgia and love for West African heritage.
